_comment: Ratchet for test-docs.mjs coverage checks (spec §9.1). Each number is the MAXIMUM allowed gap today — test-docs.mjs fails only if the live gap is BIGGER than this (a regression), never for a gap that already existed. DOC-1 lowers these numbers as it writes docs; at DOC-1 exit every one of them is 0. Regenerate honestly with `node scripts/docs/test-docs.mjs --write-baseline` after intentionally writing docs — never to silence a real regression.
